biotools.summary: bifidoAnnotator is a bioinformatics tool designed for fine-grained annotation and visualization of glycoside hydrolase (GH) genes in bifidobacteria. It focuses specifically on characterizing the enzymatic repertoire involved in the metabolism of human milk glycans (HMG).
